title: Rename application from Focus Tracker to Focus Guardian

requirements.summary: Update the application name from 'Focus Tracker' to 'Focus Guardian' in the HTML document title and metadata
acceptanceCriteria: The browser tab title displays 'Focus Guardian'
HTML meta tags reference 'Focus Guardian' where applicable

file_operations.description: Update the <title> tag from 'Focus Tracker' to 'Focus Guardian'. Update any meta tags (name, description, og:title, etc.) that reference 'Focus Tracker' to use 'Focus Guardian' instead.

requirements.summary: Update the APP_NAME constant from 'Focus Tracker' to 'Focus Guardian' in copyConstants.ts
acceptanceCriteria: All components using APP_NAME display 'Focus Guardian'

file_operations.description: Change the APP_NAME constant value from 'Focus Tracker' to 'Focus Guardian'. This constant is used throughout the application for consistent branding.

requirements.summary: Update any remaining hardcoded references to 'Focus Tracker' in user-facing text throughout the frontend codebase
acceptanceCriteria: No instances of 'Focus Tracker' appear in the UI
All user-facing text consistently uses 'Focus Guardian'

file_operations.description: Search for any hardcoded 'Focus Tracker' strings in the login page content and replace with 'Focus Guardian'. Review feature descriptions and app introduction text.
Search for any hardcoded 'Focus Tracker' strings in the layout component including sidebar navigation, header, or footer text and replace with 'Focus Guardian'.
